mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, increasing discount rates on equity valuations and compressing future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or in a tightening cycle returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market weakening, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive despite UNRATE above 4.0%, or in a labor market expansion the returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate combined with rising consumer demand (GDPC1) creates an expansionary monetary environment, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not positive when FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the INDPRO index below 100 indicates overproduction in the goods sector, leading to inventory buildup and reduced consumer spending, which compresses future earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive despite INDPRO below 100, or in a weak demand environment the returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in the federal funds rate above historical averages increases discount rates on equity valuations, compressing future cash flows and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive during a tightening cycle despite FEDFUNDS rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: High supply (INDPRO above 102) combined with weak demand (GDPC1 below 22669) creates an oversupplied market, reducing consumer demand and corporate investment, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above 102 AND GDPC1 crosses below 22669
failure_condition: 5-day returns positive despite INDPRO above 102 and GDPC1 below 22669, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE below 3.5%) and strong demand (HOUST above 1300) signal a robust labor market and healthy consumer spending, which expands corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 3.5 AND HOUST crosses above 1300
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative despite UNRATE below 3.5 and HOUST above 1300, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month window.
